# Telemetry export pipeline — FigDown source

I don't have `reference/scene.md` or `reference/layout.md` loaded (this conversation only gave me the genre-independent core), so I've composed the `block` body from the vocabulary the core document itself demonstrates — quoted labels on every block opener, bare ids, and plain `id -> id` edges — rather than inventing anything beyond that. If your build of `build-svg.js` reports a line error on the node or edge syntax, that's the signal the real `scene.md` spells it differently; run it and I'll fix per the error message.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Telemetry export pipeline"

block poller "Poller"
block normalizer "Normalizer"
block healthprobe "Health Probe"
block buffer "Ring Buffer"
block exporter "Exporter"

poller -> normalizer
healthprobe -> normalizer
normalizer -> buffer
buffer -> exporter
```

Structure captured, matching only what the description states:

- **poller** — collects raw samples from a device on a timer, feeds **normalizer**
- **healthprobe** — independently pings the device, feeds its status into the same **normalizer**
- **normalizer** — reshapes raw samples into a common schema, feeds **buffer**
- **buffer** — a ring buffer holding samples briefly, drained by **exporter**
- **exporter** — ships samples to a remote collector (the collector itself is off-figure, per the description — not drawn as a node since it isn't one of the five given ids)

Next step per the workflow: `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js telemetry-export-pipeline.fd`, fix any line error against the real block grammar, then look at the render before embedding it with its `source:` footer.
